subject: general
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

1. It started raining in the evening.

P: People ran to shelters.

Q: Water collected on roads.

R: Traffic moved slowly.

S: Many opened their umbrellas.

6. It was a heavy shower.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins with the statement "It started raining in the evening." This introduces the main event of the passage.
 
• **P comes first** as it describes the immediate reaction of the people to the rain:
 
 
• "People ran to shelters."
 
 
 
• **Q follows** as it describes the environmental consequence of the rain:
 
 
• "Water collected on roads."
 
 
 
• **R comes next** as it describes the impact on traffic due to waterlogging:
 
 
• "Traffic moved slowly."
 
 
 
• **S comes last** as it provides additional detail about people using umbrellas during the rain:
 
 
• "Many opened their umbrellas."
 
 
 
• The final sentence, "It was a heavy shower," concludes the passage effectively.
 
• The correct sequence is **PQRS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"It started raining in the evening. People ran to shelters. Water collected on roads. Traffic moved slowly. Many opened their umbrellas. It was a heavy shower."
